description.content: Converts a Lead record into Contact, Account, and/or Deal records. Allows configuration of conversion behavior including overwrite settings, notifications, owner assignment, and tag carryover.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the Lead record to convert. Must be a valid Lead ID that exists in the CRM and has not been previously converted.

response.name: Lead successfully converted. Returns details of created Contact, Account, and Deal records with their IDs and names.

response.name: Lead conversion request accepted and scheduled for processing, or contains validation errors.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the Lead record to convert. Must be a valid Lead ID that exists in the CRM and has not been previously converted.

response.name: Bad request due to invalid input data, malformed request, or attempting to convert an already converted Lead.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the Lead record to convert. Must be a valid Lead ID that exists in the CRM and has not been previously converted.

description.content: Start a scheduled mass-convert job that converts multiple leads into other modules (Deals/Contacts/Accounts) according to provided options. Max 50 lead IDs per request.

response.name: Accepted — mass convert scheduled and job id returned in details.
Bad Request — input validation or request-level errors.
Forbidden — no permission to perform the action.
Internal Server Error — unexpected server-side error.

description.content: Retrieve the status and counts of a previously scheduled mass convert job using job_id query parameter.

query.description: (Required) Identifier of the mass convert job to fetch status for.

response.name: Job status response with conversion counts.
Bad request — validation errors for job status retrieval.
Forbidden — insufficient permission to retrieve job status.

description.content: Retrieves available conversion options for a lead including matching contacts, accounts, field mappings, and layout preferences. This endpoint helps determine what conversion paths are available before performing the actual lead conversion.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the Lead record to retrieve conversion options for

response.name: Successfully retrieved lead conversion options. Returns available contacts, accounts, field mappings, and layout preferences for the specified lead.
